lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Enter your email, and we'll send you a four digit code to verify it.

lines.label: dashboard
lines.said: From your dashboard, tap New Order to begin.

lines.label: new-order
lines.said: Your new order starts out empty, so add a person to it first.

lines.label: add-party-member
lines.said: You can add yourself, or invite a party member.

lines.label: member-added
lines.said: That person is on the list now.

lines.label: item-catalogue
lines.said: Search the catalogue, or open a collection to see the items inside it.

lines.label: pick-the-dates
lines.said: Choose your pickup date, then your return date. [[slnc 300]] For a one-day rental, tap the same day twice.

lines.label: item-on-the-order
lines.said: Your item is on the order.

lines.label: the-questions
lines.said: Answer a few questions so we can have your gear ready before you get here. [[slnc 300]] Tell us your height, your boot size, your skill level, your weight and your age. [[slnc 300]] Then agree to the terms and complete the questionnaire.

lines.label: checkout
lines.said: Enter your card details to finish the rental.

lines.label: back-to-dashboard
lines.said: Your rental now shows in your order history, ready for your next visit.
